description: This file defines the main entry point of a watchOS application using SwiftUI. It sets up the app's main scene with a watch inbox view and manages communication with the watch connectivity receiver.

classes.name: OpenClawWatchApp
classes.description: Main application structure conforming to SwiftUI's App protocol, managing state and the app's main window scene.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the scene for the app, providing the main window with 'WatchInboxView' and handling reply actions with a task.
